name: Rozália Görög — a daughter Veronika baptised 1871 at Kiskunfélegyháza
researcher_question: Who were the children of Rozália Görög (born about 1860, died 30 October 1916 at Kecskemét) and her husband János Tarjányi of Kiskunfélegyháza, Pest-Pilis-Solt-Kiskun, Hungary?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-4.csv row 16, hint-samples.csv row 471, flags adds_daughter, confidence 3). Resolved 2026-10-29: false match. The hint record (ark:/61903/1:1:XZ1Y-W4K) names the mother as Rozalia Bona — not Görög — and Rozália Görög born about 1860 would have been approximately eleven in 1871, making it impossible for her to be this child's mother. Settled from the index alone; no image read was needed.
